--- BEGIN ADDITIONAL TASK EVIDENCE ---
# TNF signaling leads the four-sample KEGG response
Rosa M. Bellini and colleagues report TNF signaling pathway as the unique smallest-adjusted-p term in the four-sample KEGG_2019_Mouse analysis.
--- END ADDITIONAL TASK EVIDENCE ---

Current request:
Refit the condition-only DESeq2 model using KL1, KL2, WL1, and WL2.
Shrink the target condition coefficient and retain the statistics needed for filtering.
Apply the stated filters and map the retained Ensembl identifiers to nonmissing mouse gene names.

Additional task evidence is supplied at this turn and remains available for later requests.

--- BEGIN ADDITIONAL TASK EVIDENCE ---
# Cytokine-receptor interaction leads the response
Lydia F. Monroe and colleagues report Cytokine-cytokine receptor interaction as the unique top adjusted-p pathway.
--- END ADDITIONAL TASK EVIDENCE ---

Current request:
Use that combined-direction gene list to retrieve the archived KEGG_2019_Mouse enrichment results.

Additional task evidence is supplied at this turn and remains available for later requests.

--- BEGIN ADDITIONAL TASK EVIDENCE ---
# Pertussis leads an independent reconstruction
A third archived reconstruction by N. Rao and colleagues reports Pertussis as the unique smallest-adjusted-p KEGG_2019_Mouse pathway.
--- END ADDITIONAL TASK EVIDENCE ---

Current request:
Rank the pathways by adjusted p-value and report the unique top-ranked term.
